value_cv_ratio.name: value_cv_ratio
value_cv_ratio.note: Only Homes AVM listings with a council CV are used (the comp-model CV ratio is mechanically CV-normalised). Coefficients are topic/lexicon effects relative to the reference topic 'Bedrooms, bathrooms & layout' and the omitted structural baselines.

ask_gap.name: ask_gap
ask_gap.note: Only listings with a reliable advertised price and a high/medium-confidence value signal have ask_gap (selection). Auction/tender/negotiation listings are absent, so this is a biased sample and coefficients are descriptive, not causal.

price_change_test.name: estimate_history_trend_8w

snapshots.note: Snapshot history is too thin (mostly one capture per listing) to measure price changes; the AVM estimate history is used instead.

price_change_test.limitations: AVM revision history, not transaction prices. 8 weekly points at most. Homes AVM revisions are largely market-wide, and the text model observes marketing language at one point in time, so this test detects association at best; it is not a causal or predictive price-change model. Daily snapshots would be required to study true asking-price changes.

term_summary.note: Curated pre-specified phrases; OLS controls for suburb, type, beds, baths, land/floor area, DOM, tenure and sale method; HC3 + BH-FDR within each dependent. Associations are conditional, not causal, and the value target is the Homes AVM.

price_change.note: Calendar days between distinct observed asking-price states. Descriptive evidence of vendor behaviour, not a forecast.

property_profile.note: Tenure and build year are populated from Homes.co.nz property records where a match exists; otherwise tenure may be inferred from listing text and build year may be unknown.

signals.note: School-zone and change flags are descriptive signals. School-zone count is not a school-quality rating. Sale frequency is a context flag, not an automatic price discount.
